limitations: Frozen finalized files only; new segments after enumeration and unflushed tails are excluded. Active retention can remove files and produces explicit read errors, never fabricated continuity.

Book intervals >2s are missing freshness coverage at the simulator threshold, not automatically proof of lost exchange messages. Session changes/invalidations and aggregate-ID gaps are separate indicators.
Raw buffered receive timestamps may reverse; causal replay clamps them forward in recorded application order. Source sequence and per-segment book checks remain authoritative.
Integrity replay counts source data only. It does not inspect strategy outcomes or authorize OOS evaluation. Exact queue rank and real own fills remain unknowable from MBP.
The offline strategy runner retains its finite tape/trace caps; completing collection alone does not supply a scalable multi-day report runner.
